thesis: ANI Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ANIP), Q3 2026 10-Q filed 2026-11-05 (statements and notes read, last 3.5K characters unread). Q3 revenue 290.8M vs 227.8M (+27.6%), 9M 794.3M vs 636.3M (+24.8%); Cortrophin Gel Q3 138.7M vs 101.9M (+36%), 9M 330.9M; generics Q3 +10.4% (104.5M vs 94.4M). 9M GAAP NI 89.4M vs 50.8M; Q3 NI 35.1M, diluted EPS 1.51. TTM (FY25 + 9M26 - 9M25): revenue 1,041.3M, NI 116.8M. Close 70.89 (2026-11-16) x 22,718,931 shares (cover 2026-10-29) = market cap 1,610.5M = 13.8x TTM NI. TTM OCF 229.2M, capex 23.9M, FCF 205.3M (yield 12.7%); SBC TTM 43.0M leaves 162.3M (10.1%). Cash 420.8M, debt carrying 607.2M (convertible 2.25% notes 316.3M principal due 2029-09-01; Term Loan A 300.6M due 2029-09-16), net debt about 186M. Pending Egetis Therapeutics AB cash offer, about SEK 5.6B (~559.9M USD), funded by a 676M 364-day bridge (SOFR+2.75%) that also refinances the term loans; 42.2% irrevocable undertakings, 90% minimum tender, undertakings lapse 2027-03-31 if not unconditional. Pro forma net debt would rise toward roughly 750M (derived; EBITDA unread). The price implies the Cortrophin growth runs well below its current pace or the deal destroys value.
counterthesis: Cheap multiple is on a cash-flow-rich but concentrated base: Cortrophin is 42% of 9M revenue, and Q3 includes 11.5M brand royalties and 9M 50.7M royalties of a non-recurring or contract-limited nature (Harmony agreement). Net income is still helped by lower prior-year bases; contingent consideration gains were smaller this year (1.3M vs 25.3M in 9M), so quality of the comparison improved, but earlier-year profit was depressed by items not itemized here. The Egetis deal adds about 560M of debt-funded acquisition, a short bridge needing refinancing in capital markets, secured liens on substantially all assets, and a rare-disease asset (not yet characterized from filings). Acquired-intangible and product-right payments (5.3M in 9M) are small but historically the company grows by acquisition. SBC is high at 3-4% of revenue. 22.7M shares means each large block or secondary moves price.
invalidation: Thesis fails if Cortrophin growth stalls or net pricing/rebates erode, if the bridge cannot be termed out at reasonable cost, Egetis integration or valuation disappoints, or leverage after the deal exceeds a level that restricts cash flow.
